title: The Scheduler That Runs Jobs Too Soon
description: Deployment jobs sometimes run before their prerequisites, and circular pipelines silently produce partial schedules.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: schedule(dependencies) returns each job once, after all prerequisites, picking the lexicographically smallest ready job each step. Every dependency must be a declared job. Duplicate dependency entries count once. Cycles and missing jobs throw; empty input returns empty. Never mutate the dependency graph. C++ uses map<string,vector<string>>.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
